hero.subheadline: Designers worldwide submit posters for NYC Times Square exposure
hero.valueProposition: Golden winners receive a trophy, over 200 designers get certificates, and selected posters are exhibited on the Times Square billboard in New York City.

content.whyJoin:
Poster For is an international poster competition that frames design as a call to action. The 5th Edition invites designers and artists to express their stance on issues through poster design, with categories covering Climate, Technology, Art, Culture, and the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals.

A distinctive feature of this competition is the NYC exposure: selected posters are exhibited on the Times Square billboard in New York City in late August 2026. Every selected entrant can participate in an exhibition at least once, and winners are permanently showcased on the Poster For website and exhibition record, providing lasting visibility.

The competition awards a trophy to the golden winner in each category and issues award certificates to more than 200 awarded and selected designers. Submissions are accepted by email, and the number of submissions per designer is unlimited.
content.whoShouldApply:
This competition is for designers and artists from across the globe who want to create posters with a social purpose. It suits graphic designers, illustrators, and visual artists working on environmental protection, education, water safety, social awareness, or commercial themes.

A dedicated Drawing/Art category accepts hand-drawn posters from entrants under age 19, submitted as scanned copies, making the competition accessible to younger artists alongside professional designers.

Designers can enter in any of the six categories and submit unlimited posters, so the competition fits creators with an existing portfolio of advocacy or cause-driven poster work.

faq.question: What are the competition categories?
faq.answer: There are six categories: A. Poster for Climate, B. Poster for Technology, C. Poster for Art, D. Poster for Culture (music, literature, history, etc.), E. Poster for 17 UN SDGs Topics, and F. Drawing/Art, a hand-drawn category for entrants under age 19.

faq.question: What is the submission process?
faq.answer: Send an email to info@posterfor.com with the subject line Poster Submission, attach the completed submission form and poster files, and make the payment for the submission. Files should be named YourName_PosterName_A/B/C/D/E/F.

faq.question: What are the technical requirements?
faq.answer: For categories A-E, submit vertical JPG or PDF files sized 700 x 1000 px at 72 dpi, RGB, with a maximum file size of 10MB. For category F, submit scanned copies in A4 or Letter size at 72 dpi.

faq.question: How much does it cost to enter?
faq.answer: The entry fee is $40 per submission. The number of submissions is unlimited, so designers may submit multiple posters if they wish.

faq.question: When is the deadline and when are results announced?
faq.answer: Submissions close on July 31, 2026. The final list and top winners are announced in early August 2026, and the exhibition is held on the Times Square billboard in late August.

faq.question: What do winners receive?
faq.answer: The golden winner in each category receives a trophy. More than 200 awarded and selected designers receive an Award Certificate via email, and selected posters are exhibited on the Times Square billboard in New York City.

submissionGuide.detail: Design a vertical poster for one of the six categories. For categories A-E use 700 x 1000 px at 72 dpi, RGB, JPG or PDF, under 10MB. For category F, hand-draw and scan in A4 or Letter size at 72 dpi.
Download the submission form from the Poster For website and fill it out with your details, including name, age, gender, country, and email.
Email your poster and the filled form to info@posterfor.com with the subject line Poster Submission. Use Latin letters only and name files YourName_PosterName_A/B/C/D/E/F.
Make the $40 payment per submission. Confirm that your payment is processed before the July 31, 2026 deadline.

submissionGuide.step: Await the results and send high-res files if selected
submissionGuide.detail: Results are announced in early August 2026. Selected designers in categories A-E must send a 300 dpi file at 70 x 100 cm in CMYK, and category F designers send an A4 or Letter scan at 300 dpi.
